registers.label: Spare
lines: As they watched, he was lifted up,
and a cloud took him from their sight.
God has gone up with a shout,
the Lord with the sound of the trumpet.
His hands were raised in blessing over us.
We are sent to be his witnesses.
Lift up your hearts!
Christ reigns. Come, let us worship. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Watch with the eleven on the hillside as he raises his wounded hands above them, still blessing as he goes, until a cloud receives him.
Lift up your hearts: Christ reigns!
Hear the trumpet and the shout go up — God has ascended, and the King of glory is seated above every power and name.
Lift up your hearts: Christ reigns!
Why do you stand looking up to heaven? There is a world to love and a gospel to carry, and you will be his witnesses.
Lift up your hearts: Christ reigns!
So clap your hands, all you peoples; sing praises to our God, sing praises.
Lift up your hearts: Christ reigns!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: He lifted his hands, blessed them, and was carried from their sight.
Lift up your hearts: Christ reigns!
God has gone up with a shout and the sound of the trumpet.
Lift up your hearts: Christ reigns!
Why stand gazing up? You will be his witnesses.
Lift up your hearts: Christ reigns!
Clap your hands, all you peoples. Come, let us worship.
Lift up your hearts: Christ reigns!
